title: Panel update
scope: Online update installs new versions of the Cairn panel only. No other software on this server is changed.
upToDate: You are running the latest version.

confirm.title: Install version {version}?
confirm.content: The panel restarts during the update and is unreachable for a short time. If the update fails, the previous version is restored automatically where possible.

reason.dev_build: This is a development build, which cannot be updated online.
reason.cloud_disabled: Update checks are off because the cloud service is turned off.
reason.no_trusted_key: No release signing key is configured yet, so updates cannot be verified.
reason.fetch_failed: The release information could not be downloaded. Check the service address and the server's network connection.
reason.verification_failed: The release information failed signature verification and was ignored.

job.timeoutTitle: The panel did not come back
job.timeout: There was no answer for 3 minutes. Check the Cairn service on the server, then check again.
job.reloadHint: Reload the page to load the new version of the interface.

cloud.enabled: Connect to the Cairn cloud service
cloud.helpDownloadOnly: The panel only downloads signed public data from this address, such as official messages and release information. It never uploads anything.
cloud.helpDisable: Turning it off also turns off official messages and update checks.
cloud.helpMirror: The address can point to a self-hosted mirror.
